name: Gloss Stare
description: Fix a polished glare on the foe so that his eyes slip across the user as across a pane of glass.

name: Smear Jab
description: Jab with a smeared image of the arm so that the foe sees a blur and not the point of impact.

name: Gauze Turn
description: Turn the body inside a gauze of images so that the blow tears only a copy.

name: Lull Stride
description: Stride forward at an even pace that hides the moment of the sudden lunge.

name: Ghost Volley
description: Loose a flight of pale bolts of which each seems to come from a different hand.

name: Simulacrum Guard
description: Raise a simulacrum of the user that stands in the guard and absorbs the strikes meant for the body.

name: Lens Probe
description: Shape qi into a lens and pass it over the field to bring every false shape into hard relief.

name: Grand Semblance
description: Raise a grand semblance of an army at the user's back that draws the aim of every foe in view.

name: Specter Cascade
description: Pour a cascade of specters across the ground that wound every foe they pass through.

name: Eidolon Break
description: Vanish as an eidolon and reappear inside the foe's guard to strike with the full weight of the user's body.

name: Masked Palm
description: Strike with a palm wearing the mask of a closed fist so that the foe braces for the wrong blow.

name: Doubled Glaze
description: Lay two glazes over the eyes of the foe so that each image hides the other.

name: Faceted Guard
description: Present a cut-glass facet at the forearm so that a strike skates off at an unexpected angle.

name: Twin Wander
description: Drift to the right while a twin seems to drift to the left and draw the eye after it.

name: Pair Lens
description: Hold two lenses of qi before the eyes and read a glamour from both sides at once.

name: Masquerade Veil
description: Set a veil of many masks over the user so that the foe cannot fix on a single face.

name: Dual Visage
description: Wear two faces in turn at the front and back of the head so that no angle of attack is clear.

name: Visage Lance
description: Thrust a lance wearing the face of a harmless hand that pierces the guard when the mask falls away.

name: Mask Exchange
description: Swap faces and places with a double at the instant of a blow so that the foe strikes his own ally or the air.

name: Twin Chimera
description: Loose two chimeras of false flesh that rush through the field and wound all they touch.

name: Absolute Masquerade
description: Cast a masquerade so complete that the foe's mind accepts its wounds as real and suffers them in the flesh.

name: Dim Flicker
description: Flicker the light about the foe's head so that his eyes cannot hold a stable image.

name: Mirage Rap
description: Rap the foe's guard with a hand that seems to be still a long way off.

name: Shimmering Guard
description: Make the air shiver round the body so that blows go astray in the trembling light.

name: Wisp Barrage
description: Let fly a dense barrage of wisps that burn bright and vanish in the instant they strike.

name: Shiver Trace
description: Follow the faint shiver that every glamour makes in the air back to the one who cast it.

name: Clarity Wash
description: Wash an ally's mind clean of lingering phantoms with a calm cold flow of qi.

name: Phantasm Procession
description: March a long column of phantoms through the foes that strike each in turn and fade behind.

name: Seeming Shroud
description: Draw a heavy shroud of seeming over the user and allies so that the field outside sees only empty ground.

name: Mirage Sovereign
description: Rule the mirage so wholly that the user may pass through any foe who believes the user is not there.

name: Prism Rap
description: Rap with a fist that splits into several colored images and lands as only one.

name: Dapple Veil
description: Dapple the foe's sight with shifting patches of light that break up the user's outline.

name: Fractured Guard
description: Break the incoming strike into bright shards at the guard so that it scatters wide.

name: Mote Stride
description: Dissolve into drifting motes for one stride and gather again a body's length away.

name: Glint Lens
description: Catch the glint of a false image in a lens of qi and trace it back to its source.

name: Prism Rain
description: Rain bright prismatic needles over the foe that split into many images as they fall.

name: Glint Mantle
description: Wear a mantle of glints that dazzles the eye and softens every blow that lands on it.

name: Refraction Snare
description: Bend the light into a snare that seems to be only a trick of the eye but holds the foe fast.

name: Mote Cleansing
description: Dissolve the dark motes of a clinging hallucination from an ally's sight with a stream of clear light.

name: Refraction Trap
description: Plant a hidden refraction in the ground that bursts into a storm of false shapes when a foe steps near.

name: Chroma Storm
description: Whip a storm of color through the air that buffets all within it with the weight of real blows.

name: Chromatic Judgment
description: Pass a prismatic judgment on the foe's sight and mind that leaves wounds where no blade has touched.

name: Quiet Glaze
description: Lay a quiet glaze over the foe's hearing so that the sound of the user's motion is lost.

name: Hush Fist
description: Strike with a fist that makes no sound and casts no shadow until it lands.

name: Lull Shield
description: Raise a soft shield of stillness that dulls the foe's will to press the attack.

name: Hover Pace
description: Hover a breath above the ground in a pace that leaves no sound or mark.

name: Gentle Phantasm
description: Show a company of foes a gentle phantasm of their own home so that their grip loosens.

name: Soft Counterfeit
description: Loose a counterfeit bolt that makes no sign of its flight and explodes softly at the target.

name: Waking Chime
description: Ring a single clear chime of qi that wakes allies from every planted vision at once.

name: Silent Spectacle
description: Show an entire company a silent spectacle so vivid that it knocks the weaker among them senseless.

name: Hushed Mantle
description: Wrap the user and the nearest allies in a mantle of hush that moves with them unseen.

name: Silent Dominion
description: Impose a silence on the whole company so deep that no foe can raise a hand or a technique against the user.

name: Draft Shimmer
description: Stir a draft of shimmering air in the foe's face that makes the user seem to waver.

name: Zephyr Rap
description: Rap the guard with a blow that arrives on a light breath and weighs more than it seems.

name: Draft Turn
description: Turn on a draft of false air that carries the foe's blow along and past the body.

name: Zephyr Stride
description: Stride lightly on a breath of wind while a copy of the body takes a different path.

name: Weather Eye
description: Read the drift of the air for the unnatural stillness that marks a glamour held in place.

name: Zephyr Mirage
description: Blow a mirage across the field on a steady breeze so that it changes as it travels.

name: Vapor Volley
description: Send up a rank of vapor-shaped bolts that cross and strike from every side.

name: Gust Mantle
description: Wrap a mantle of shifting gusts and images about the body so that blows are scattered.

name: Oathbound Spectacle
description: Swear a spectacle to the field so that every foe who looks upon it is held where he stands.

name: Seeming Squall
description: Whirl a squall of seeming across the ground that tears at the senses and strikes with real force.

name: Sworn Apparition
description: Call up an apparition sworn to the user's oath that strikes the foe down and holds him under its gaze.

name: Mundane Glamour
description: Cast an unremarkable glamour that makes the user look like part of the ground.

name: Level Rap
description: Rap straight at the foe's chest on an even line that gives no clue to its timing.

name: Low Mirror
description: Hold a low mirror of qi at the hip to send a thrust away along the ground.

name: Even Mirage
description: Spread an even mirage in which every distance reads as equal and the foe cannot judge his reach.

name: Flat Phantom
description: Slide a phantom flat along the ground and lift it into a lance beneath the foe's stance.

name: Placid Reading
description: Sink into calm and read the true distance and number of every figure in view.

name: Unmeasured Reach
description: Strike from a distance the foe has been led to misjudge so that the blow lands before he moves.

name: Counterfeit Footing
description: Lay a formation of level false ground that dulls the footing and the aim of every foe on it.

name: Level Collapse
description: Fold the false flatness of the field in upon itself so that every foe falls as if the ground had given way.

name: Oath Glaze
description: Swear a glaze over the foe's eyes that holds the user's image still in a false place.

name: Vowed Rap
description: Rap the foe on the line of a vow so that the blow cannot be talked out of its path.

name: Held Mirror
description: Hold a mirror of qi unwavering at the guard to send the attack along a vowed angle.

name: Pledge Pace
description: Pace out of line while a pledged copy stays to answer the blow.

name: Witness Eye
description: Bear witness with the whole gaze and fix a glamour in place until its edges are plain.

name: Sworn Scene
description: Swear a single false scene to a company so that every member sees it the same.

name: Vowed Phantasm
description: Loose a phantasm vowed to its mark that bends after the foe through every dodge.

name: Pledge Barrier
description: Raise a barrier of pledged images that does not give way while the user holds the oath.

name: Oathbreak Rinse
description: Rinse an ally free of a false oath or a forced vision laid on his mind.

name: Unbroken Scene
description: Hold the false scene unbroken against every effort of the foes to look away from it.

name: Oath Cascade
description: Pour the weight of the sworn scene on the foes until they are bowed down by its pressure.

name: Vowed Sovereign Sight
description: Extend the oath of clear sight to allies so that each sees through glamour as the user does.

name: Sworn Scene Unbroken
description: Bind the senses of the whole company to one oath-sworn scene and keep them there until the user releases it.

name: Compass Glaze
description: Glaze a foe's sense of direction so that the user seems to stand in two places.

name: Course Rap
description: Rap along a false course that bends at the last moment onto the true target.

name: Slant Mirror
description: Slant a mirror of qi against the incoming blow to turn its direction.

name: Unwavering Pace
description: Move at a fixed pace on a fixed line while a copy veers off and draws the eye.

name: Wind Phantasm
description: Loose phantasms that the wind seems to carry and that curve in flight to the target.

name: Directional Lie
description: Tell the foe's senses a steady lie about the direction of the wind and the position of the user.

name: Heading Reckoning
description: Fix the true heading of every figure in the field and note which ones drift against the wind.

name: Wrong North
description: Turn the sense of north in every foe within the field until none can march in a straight line.

name: Bearing Storm
description: Rush a storm of fixed false bearings through the foes that tears at their balance and aim.

name: Absolute Misleading
description: Make every sense of a company point away from the user and flash to any chosen spot unseen.

name: Hush Glaze
description: Glaze the foe's senses with a hush that makes the user's presence slip from notice.

name: Murmur Fist
description: Strike with a fist that murmurs a false rhythm in the air and breaks it at the point of impact.

name: Stillness Guard
description: Hold the guard in a stillness that seems to swallow the force of any blow near it.

name: Slow Roll
description: Roll slowly out of line under a hush so that the foe fails to mark the move.

name: Hush Sense
description: Listen into the hush with qi in the ears to find any sound that the glamour has not covered.

name: Hushed Phantasm
description: Roll a hushed phantasm over a group so that no one in it can hear a warning.

name: Murmur Shot
description: Loose a bolt that murmurs a false tune and detonates when the foe turns toward its sound.

name: Gale Hush Veil
description: Draw a veil of hush before the company that softens each blow and the sound of the fight.

name: Quiet Clearing
description: Quiet the din of a forced vision in an ally's mind and let his own thoughts return.

name: Rolling Hush
description: Roll a long hush over the field that stills every ear and strikes the weak senseless.

name: Hushed Presence
description: Step through the hush so that the user and the nearest allies cannot be marked or targeted.

name: Hush Absolute
description: Still every sense and every technique within the company until none can strike while the hush endures.
